notes: בֶן־בִּנְךָ read as outer construct *son* (t027), rectum *son’s* (t026) and suffix *thy* (t025): an English possessive takes the determiner of the possessor, so the suffix holds it under rules 18 and 29, and nothing is fronted.
כָּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ: no article morpheme stands in the chain, so the single written *the* is supplied on יְמֵי, the word it stands before (rule 29), and חַיֶּי takes the relational *of* (rule 19).
